notes:
BUILT: (1) /admin SuperAdmin screen — new src/features/admin slice: AdminFleetsPage (list + create-fleet form, shows returned one-time password ONCE via role=status panel, data-testid=one-time-password), useAdminFleets hook (getAdminFleets/postCreateFleet/postDeactivateFleet), createFleetForm pure module, AdminGuard + adminRoleGating. Route added to router.tsx as a NEW top-level /admin group (lazy chunk AdminFleetsPage-*.js confirmed separate in dist 7.76kB), STANDALONE (not under the fleet-scoped AppLayout — SuperAdmin is fleetless), guarded by AdminGuard (redirects non-SuperAdmin to /x/login). /d and /c routes untouched. (2) /x/settings Fleet tab — REWROTE the previously read-only FleetTab into an editable self-service form (name/phone/primary color picker+hex input/PNG logo upload with preview+client pre-check/welcome text/offer timeout/SMS cap/DISABLED auto-dispatch toggle), wired to PUT /fleet/settings + POST /fleet/logo via useFleetSettingsMutations. fleetSettingsForm.ts is the pure validation/mapping module. (3) Customer runtime branding (AC#4) — name+primaryColorHex were ALREADY applied by the existing customer/shell useFleetBranding+fleetBranding+CustomerLayout (reused — did NOT duplicate into the WI's fictional customer/branding/ path, which would be a cross-feature dup). ADDED the missing pieces: logo in the CustomerLayout header, welcomeText

on CustomerHomePage, and a gdpr footer link (href=/gdpr.md, t('customer.footer.gdpr')). (4) docs/runbook.md (Caddy *.{domain} wildcard block + DNS-01 + Host/X-Fleet-Slug tenant resolution + demo.localhost/second.localhost local options + create-superadmin CLI note) and DEMO.md (Lighthouse a11y manual-run table for the 3 UC-007 screens). (5) onboarding.spec.ts + playwright.config.ts comment. ===== CLIENT CONTRACTS (reconciled byte-for-byte against the REAL laneA5/A6 records): POST /admin/fleets body {slug,name,phone,adminEmail} -> {fleetId,slug,adminEmail,oneTimePassword}; GET /admin/fleets -> {items: AdminFleetDto[]} (items envelope, AdminFleetDto={id,slug,name,phone,isActive,createdAt}); POST /admin/fleets/{id}/deactivate -> 204. PUT /fleet/settings body {name,phone,primaryColorHex(#RRGGBB|null),welcomeText(|null),offerTimeoutSeconds(10..600),smsMonthlyCapCzk(>=0),autoDispatchEnabled} -> 204. POST /fleet/logo multipart field 'file' -> 204 (postFleetLogo does NOT use apiRequest — apiRequest force-sets Content-Type application/json which breaks multipart; it uses manual fetch+FormData mirroring fetchDriverReportCsv). GET /public/fleet EXTENDED additively: PublicFleetResponse gained welcomeText:string|null + logoUrl:string|null (backend GetFleetResponse already returns them; the client type was stale). Made them REQUIRED (not optional) since the backend record always returns them; updated 3 customer test fixtures that build PublicFleetResponse inline. ===== ⚠ HANDOFF #1 (API-LANE BLOCKER for the conductor — the single thing to watch): there is NO way to authenticate a SuperAdmin today. StaffLoginEndpoint resolves the user WITHIN a fleet by slug and only accepts Driver/Dispatcher/FleetAdmin; a SuperAdmin has FleetId=null and belongs to no slug, so even removing the role filter would not let them in (structural fleet-scoping). Consequence: the /admin screen is UNREACHABLE in production until the API adds a SuperAdmin auth branch (a SuperAdmin path in StaffLoginEndpoint that skips fleet resolution, or a dedicated /auth/superadmin/login endpoint). I did NOT forge a JWT, invent a non-existent route, or touch api/** (all explicitly rejected). The admin client fns point at the REAL existing /admin/* routes so tsc/build/unit stay green (unit mocks the client). When the API adds SuperAdmin auth, /admin + the e2e SuperAdmin step light up with no web change. The create-fleet CHAIN itself works: POST /admin/fleets provisions Fleet+FleetSettings+Tariff+FleetAdmin (IsActive=true, SmsMonthlyCapCzk=500 default) and returns the one-time password; DispatcherOrCustomer policy INCLUDES FleetAdmin (verified AuthorizationPolicies.cs lines 68-73) so the new FleetAdmin can POST /orders directly — no separate Dispatcher needed for fleet 2. ===== HOW THE E2E OBTAINS A SUPERADMIN: beforeAll runs the create-superadmin CLI (`dotnet run --project api/src/Taxi.Api --no-build --no-launch-profile -- create-superadmin --email superadmin@demo.local --password Super1234!`) against the harness DB (localhost:5432, Seed__Enabled=false). --no-build avoids a build lock against the running API. The bootstrapper is idempotent. The spec then gets a SuperAdmin token via POST /auth/staff/login (slug=the new fleet slug) — THIS STEP DEPENDS ON HANDOFF #1; if the API cannot mint a SuperAdmin token yet, AC3_Onboarding throws a clear message at apiLogin and the conductor knows exactly why. The SuperAdmin create-fleet is driven over the API (the /admin UI does the same POST; a browser-login for SuperAdmin is blocked by #1, documented in the spec header). If the conductor prefers seeding a SuperAdmin over the CLI step, that is an api-lane change (DevelopmentSeeder). ===== SECOND-FLEET via ?fleet= (AC#4) + WHY: no *.localhost wildcard DNS locally, so the spec drives the second fleet with the app's existing ?fleet={slug} override (resolveFleetSlug fallback: subdomain -> ?fleet= -> /c/f/{slug} -> demo). Loads /c?fleet=druha-flotila and asserts the new fleet's name (h1), welcome text, and primary color (computed background of the 'Vlastní adresa' primary button == rgb(233,30,99) for #E91E63). The branding path is identical to a real subdomain; only the slug SOURCE differs. Documented in the spec header + docs/runbook.md. The fleet is branded (color+welcome) via PUT /fleet/settings in AC3 first, because POST /admin/fleets leaves primaryColorHex null (request has no color) -> otherwise the customer would fall back to the base theme, identical to demo, making 'own color' unprovable. ===== EXACT SELECTORS/LABELS the conductor's e2e relies on (Czech, default locale): customer h1 = fleet name; welcome

text = the fleet's welcomeText; primary button getByRole('button',{name:'Vlastní adresa'}) background. Admin create-fleet form labels: 'Identifikátor (slug)', 'Název', 'Telefon', 'E-mail správce'; submit 'Vytvořit flotilu'; one-time password data-testid='one-time-password'. Fleet tab labels: 'Název flotily','Telefon flotily','Barva značky'/'Barevný kód','Logo flotily','Uvítací text','Časový limit nabídky (s)','Měsíční limit SMS (Kč)'; submit 'Uložit'; auto-dispatch data-testid='auto-dispatch-toggle' (disabled). ===== CONTRACT ASSUMPTIONS TO WATCH: (a) POST /staff add-driver body is {email,displayName,role,phone} (matches CreateStaffRequest, verified). (b) POST /orders body reuses the UC-002/003 dispatcher shape (pickup/dropoff lat/lng + customerPhone + priceType Fixed + fixedPriceCzk), response {order:{id,publicCode}} — matches the existing apiDriver helper. (c) onboarding slug 'druha-flotila' assumes the harness resets the DB per run (webServer reuseExistingServer:false + down -v) so no 409 dup-slug; the spec throws a clear message if a 409 occurs. (d) POST /fleet/logo multipart field name 'file' — the backend reads Files[0] (index-based, field name not asserted), so 'file' is safe. ===== FLEET TAB FULL-PUT CLOBBER RISK (documented, advisor-caught): PUT /fleet/settings is a REPLACE. GET /fleet/settings returns only {name,phone,offerTimeoutSeconds,autoDispatchEnabled} — NOT color/welcome/smsCap. The form pre-fills color+welcome from GET /public/fleet (which returns them) and logoUrl for the preview; smsMonthlyCapCzk is not exposed by EITHER read, so it seeds from the UC-005-additive FleetSettingsDto.smsMonthlyCapCzk when present else the server default 500. RESIDUAL RISK: if a fleet's actual smsMonthlyCapCzk differs from 500 and neither read exposes it, the first save from a fresh tab load would reset it to 500. Recommend the conductor/api add smsMonthlyCapCzk (and ideally primaryColorHex/welcomeText) to the GetFleetSettings read DTO to fully close this — web will read it the moment it appears (FleetSettingsDto already types smsMonthlyCapCzk optional). ===== ROUTE/GUARD APPROACH: /admin is a new top-level lazy route (not /x/*). AdminGuard reads authStorage.getUserRole()==='SuperAdmin' and redirects others to /x/login (minimal guard; the app had no SuperAdmin routing). No AppLayout nav link to /admin (SuperAdmins are fleetless; they reach /admin directly). canAccessSettings still FleetAdmin-only, so the /x/settings Fleet tab remains FleetAdmin-gated via the existing SettingsPage guard. ===== NO /d or /c ROUTE removed/repurposed; customer changes are additive (logo/welcome/footer). No api/** touched. onboarding.spec.ts NOT collected by vitest (vitest.config exclude '**/e2e/**' — confirmed suite ran 1087 with no onboarding file) and runs ONLY in the chromium desktop project (mobile projects use testMatch driver/customer; onboarding matches neither -> no double-run).
